title: Diffuse beam after RF phase drift
text: Similar diffuse off-center beam was corrected by verifying RF phase before increasing quadrupole strength.
recommended_action: Take an OTR calibration measurement and check RF phase before increasing quad_2.

title: Quadrupole correction amplified halo
text: Increasing quad_2 during an RF phase drift made the beam halo worse in the synthetic replay.
recommended_action: Hold quadrupole correction until the RF cavity readback is reconciled.

title: Post-calibration RF trim recovered beam
risk_tags: a small RF phase correction plus a limited quadrupole trim restored the synthetic beam profile.
column6: Approve a small RF phase correction and verify with BPM/BCM readbacks.
